verdict.rationale: Dover's docs say it supports an interview plan and collects structured feedback from every interviewer, which touches the core of structured scorecards. That is a single thin mention, with no detail on how the scorecards are built or used. missing for 10: defined attributes per interview stage, focused rubrics assigned per interviewer, cross-candidate comparison of scores, in-depth scorecard documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews are scored on structured scorecards — defined attributes per stage, focused rubrics per interviewer, comparable across candidates

citations.quote: Set up your interview plan, schedule candidates, and collect structured feedback from every interviewer.
